plugins.description: AI Integrator gives your company an operating system that keeps working when nobody is watching. One install brings the Blueprint: skills that prepare and debrief your calls, keep your CRM honest, chase what has stalled, clean up your own reference files, check your setup, and run your scheduled work unattended — plus the single connector they all reach your tools through. Sign your tools in once in the Command Center (Settings → Admin → Company tools) and the skills do the rest. Start by saying 'patch me up' or 'set me up'. More at aiintegratorhq.com.
